name: Orphans Benefit and Unsupported Childs Benefit products
description: A suite of additional assistance products available to caregivers who meet specific qualifications and are receiving Orphans Benefit or Unsupported Childs Benefit.

attributes.summary: Additional financial assistance products for caregivers receiving Orphans Benefit or Unsupported Childs Benefit, covering clothing, establishment costs, extraordinary care needs, holiday and birthday celebrations, and school start-up costs.
attributes.eligibility: Caregivers who meet specific qualifications and are receiving Orphans Benefit or Unsupported Childs Benefit
attributes.payment_details: Includes Clothing Allowance (weekly payment, automatic), Establishment Grant (one-off payment, automatic on approval), Extraordinary Care Fund (grant, application required), Holiday Allowance and Birthday Allowance (annual payment, generally automatic), and School and Year Start-up Payment (annual payment, application required). All components are non-taxable.
attributes.application_process: Some components (Extraordinary Care Fund, School and Year Start-up Payment) require clients to apply. Others are paid automatically (Clothing Allowance, Establishment Grant, Holiday and Birthday Allowance).
